label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: When they saw the _____, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
verse: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
note: The wise men had followed it a long way — when the star stood over the place, their joy ran over.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an _____.
verse: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.
note: Proof the risen Jesus wasn't a spirit: he ate broiled fish in front of them — and the KJV adds a honeycomb.

label: Deep Water
prompt: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath _____ him.
verse: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
note: The prologue's finale: no one has seen God, but the Son from the Father's bosom has made him known.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour _____ one another;
verse: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;
note: 'In honour preferring one another' — Paul's idea of competition: outdo each other in showing respect.
